intro: Вы можете указать полный путь к папке, как полный адрес, чтобы найти свой дом.
layout: Top-left: title (2 lines) + intro. Top-right (x~555-1500, y~45-460): flow diagram Home → User → 3 folders. Middle row (y~475-820): 4 step cards side by side, joined by orange chevrons '>' between them; each card: numbered orange circle, title, icon + description, macOS-style terminal (3 dots) at bottom. Prompt colors: 'kali@kali' orange, ':' white, '~' / '~/Documents' cyan-blue, '$' white; pwd output in cyan-blue. Bottom (y~842-957): wide info box with orange filled 'i' circle.

blocks.desc: Horizontal flow at top-right (y~45-460). Glowing 3D orange house icon with label 'Home' (orange, bold) and '/home/kali' (white) below → orange arrow → glowing 3D orange user icon with label 'User' (orange) and '/home/kali' below → orange line that splits via a vertical bracket into three arrows pointing right to three 3D folders stacked vertically: top folder (dark, monitor icon) with 'Desktop' (white bold) / '/home/kali/Desktop'; middle folder (dark, download-arrow icon) with 'Downloads' (white bold) / '/home/kali/Downloads'; bottom folder (highlighted, glowing orange, document icon) with 'Documents' (orange bold) / '/home/kali/Documents' (orange) — Documents is the active target.
